rationale: The agent did not complete the user’s requests per policy. While it appeared to look up the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip and get_user_details), it proceeded to cancel a pending order (#W5166363) without first confirming the action with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing write. It also did not show that the order belonged to the user or matched the described five-item pending order, and there is no evidence of tool results supporting that selection. Additionally, the agent failed to address the exchange request for the recently purchased laptop to an i9 configuration with the specified preferences. The conversation ended with a goodbye without confirming outcomes or providing final details. These issues constitute policy failures and incomplete task fulfillment.
